programs.title: Building Trades Reads the Numbers: Locator.X Evidence Lab
outcomes: Read a parcel record and its evidence grade before trusting any figure
Explain DSCR 1.20 break-even and the seven-gate screen in plain language
Identify parish data traps and why cancelled capital is weighted to zero
Use forecast bands (~80%) instead of single-point claims when planning work

sessions.activity: Guided tour with the Guide agent: navigate portfolio summary and market editions; learners locate a Louisiana parcel and compare it against the Bay Area premium map.
Small groups grade three sample records using coverage-first rules and the sample floor of 5; each group writes the explicit list of unknowns they find.
Hands-on run of the seven-gate LOCATOR screen on one real New Orleans parcel; debate whether DSCR 1.20 break-even holds and defend the verdict.
Learners query the Developer Brief Desk role-only agent on what a chosen parish record supports and what it caps at; draft a one-page jobs-impact note.

programs.data_shared: Anonymised exercise outcomes: gate-pass/fail tallies per parish, count of certainty errors found, and de-identified worksheet scores feed shared curriculum benchmarks. No names, employers, or parcel ownership details are collected.
programs.consent: Voluntary opt-in at enrollment with a one-page plain-language notice; shop stewards may accompany. Learners consent only to aggregate, anonymised exercise data and may withdraw at any time with their worksheets deleted.

programs.title: Map Facts, Not Map Guesses: A Jackson Square Field Study
outcomes: Locate Jackson Square and the Mississippi riverfront on a map and describe the urban-park biome
Distinguish evidence-graded data from unverified claims using the sample floor of 5
Read a forecast band and explain why a range beats a single number
Present a parcel verdict with an explicit unknowns list

sessions.activity: Virtual tour starting at the Jackson Square anchor; students navigate to market editions and mark one emerging-market Louisiana parcel for study.
Evidence detective exercise: students grade sample numbers by coverage and list unknowns; count and log certainty errors as a class scoreboard.
Guided entry lessons from the 92-lesson curriculum: reading what the platform produces; short level-gate quiz graded on a real parcel.
Team walkthrough of the seven-gate screen with the teacher; teams state a supported-or-not verdict with reasons and unknowns.

programs.data_shared: Only aggregate classroom tallies: number of certainty errors counted, gate verdicts by team (no names), and anonymised quiz scores for curriculum benchmarking. No individual student data leaves the classroom.
programs.consent: Signed guardian/parent consent forms required before participation, plus school approval; the notice states only aggregated, anonymised tallies are shared, parents may review materials, and any student may opt out without penalty.

programs.title: Housing Evidence Bootcamp: Reading the Louisiana Record
outcomes: Audit a parish record for coverage, sample size, and named data traps
Explain why cancelled capital is weighted to zero and what that means for community claims
Produce an evidence-graded brief a board can act on
Train residents to read forecast bands responsibly

sessions.activity: Staff work the parish-by-parish coverage map with the Developer Brief Desk role-only agent, documenting what each record supports and caps at.
Audit workshop: teams grade ten figures from the review digest, apply the sample floor of 5, and draft the unknowns disclosure for a community meeting.
Select curriculum items from the 19 tracks matched to staff roles; each participant completes a level gate on a real parcel and logs certainty errors.
Compare the emerging-market map against the Bay Area premium map; teams present where evidence supports relocation-versus-investment narratives.

programs.data_shared: Anonymised audit results: error counts by parish, gate capability tallies, and de-identified brief-quality rubric scores, shared as aggregate benchmarks across participating organisations. No client or resident identities are included.
programs.consent: Organisation-level data-sharing agreement plus individual staff opt-in; participants see the aggregate-only schema before contributing and may withdraw their audit tallies at any time.

programs.title: Nonprofit Underwriting Literacy for Neighborhood Boards
outcomes: Interpret the seven-gate LOCATOR screen and DSCR 1.20 break-even for funding conversations
Apply coverage-before-rate and the sample floor of 5 to any number in a grant narrative
Build a quarterly evidence review routine using the Review Agent digest
Escalate unknowns instead of guessing in public statements

sessions.activity: Board orientation: Guide agent tour of portfolio summary and cross-market comparison; each board adopts one Louisiana parcel to track for a quarter.
Facilitated mock underwrite: leaders run the seven-gate screen, interpret the ~80% forecast band, and vote on a documented go/no-go exercise (advisory only, no enacted proposals).
Policy drafting session: boards write a one-page evidence standard using coverage grading, sample floor of 5, and an unknowns disclosure for public materials.
Leaders enroll in selected curriculum items from the 50-item program; level-gate results become a shared capability baseline for the board.
Quarterly review: teams read the Review Agent digest, update their parcel watch list, and practice the 12-month re-underwrite flip scan discussion.

programs.data_shared: Anonymised board-level metrics only: aggregate gate pass rates, certainty-error counts, and de-identified rubric scores on evidence-standard drafts, contributed to shared model benchmarks. No beneficiary, donor, or parcel-owner identities are shared.
programs.consent: Board resolution plus individual sign-off covers aggregate data contribution; a plain-language privacy notice limits sharing to anonymised tallies, and any board or member may withdraw participation and have their aggregates removed.
